feeds.title: The Blogging Goth » Music
feeds.description: The Blogging Goth talks about heavy rock music and discusses new releases, artists, albums, and more. The Blogging Goth is a news-orientated blog founded in 2011, written and edited by a trained journalist, and aims to report on significant events and issues from within the UK Goth scene.

feeds.title: Dj De'Ath Blog
feeds.description: DJ DeAth shares gothic music, reviews, setlists, concerts, cd reviews, alternatives, and more on this blog. DJ DeAth got into music with the birth of punk around 1977. Dj De'Ath plays a unique deathwave mix of Gothic / Dark alternative featuring old gems and new classics from across the black planet, the black world of Goth Rock, Deathrock, Cold-Wave, and more.

feeds.title: Metal Music Blog » Gothic Metal
feeds.description: Top and latest gothic metal genre music albums and releases. The aim of Metal music blog is not to sabotage the music, on the contrary, to spread it out; and to present to people the albums that cannot be accessed by many countries.

feeds.title: Onyx Music Reviews » Goth
feeds.description: Onyx Music Reviews connects gothic aesthetic lovers with the genre of music through their in-depth reviews. My name is Adele. Music has been a passion for my whole life fueled by my parents. Onyx Music Reviews endeavors to cover dark alternative music that you may or may not be familiar with: whether well-established or up and coming. Genres include gothic, post-punk, deathrock, darkwave, coldwave, new wave, synth, EBM, industrial, and some metal.

feeds.title: Markus' Heavy Music Blog » Gothic
feeds.description: Read about gothic music on Markus' Heavy Music Blog. I'm Markus and this is my blog. I started Markus' Heavy Music Blog back in 2013. What you can read on Markus' Heavy Music Blog is not more, but also no less, than my view on metal music when it comes to CDs, vinyl, live shows, and more.

feeds.title: Angry Metal Guy » Gothic Rock
feeds.description: Angry Metal Guy writes about gothic rock music and shares music reviews, interviews, and more. The blog connects metals lovers to the music their soul speaks to.

feeds.title: Louder Than War » Gothic Reviews
feeds.description: Read all about Goth Reviews on Louder Than War, the home of contemporary music, film & culture! Louder Than War is a music, culture, and media publication headed by The Membranes & Goldblade frontman John Robb. We are always looking for the new noise, the next buzz. We have no borders, no boundaries - all the musical skree of the 21st century is ours to celebrate.

feeds.title: Metal Odyssey » Gothic Rock
feeds.description: Metal Odyssey shares articles on gothic rock music in this segment where they post band news, new releases, upcoming tours & concerts, and more. The site also highlights other genres such as classic rock, hard rock, and more.

feeds.title: Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog » Gothic
feeds.description: The following section of Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog is dedicated to goth music & artists. Flying Fiddlesticks Music Blog is dedicated to music for its own sake. We write recaps and reviews of music festivals in order to promote live music as a life-improving experience. We cover new music releases and conduct interviews with artists to help get the word out.

feeds.title: Cadaver Kelly » Music + Media
feeds.description: Cadaver shares her love for anything gothic, be it music, film, literature, or more here. 'Cadaver' Kelly is a YouTuber, underground music journalist, alternative subculture historian, goth music educator, and DJ. She makes educational goth talk content as well as album reviews, music release announcements, and live events coverage.

feeds.title: Music Existence » Gothic
feeds.description: Music Existence dedicates this segment of the site to gothic music and shares insightful articles on new releases, bands, singles, theatrical music, and more. Music Existence is your source to find new music, watch videos, get information on upcoming tours, and read exclusive interviews.

feeds.title: World Of Goth Blog
feeds.description: World Of Goth is a printed magazine publication.American Print Magazine For the Regal Goth. Art, Entertainment, Fashion, Film and Literature, Interviews, Life Style, Music, Reviews, Journalism. We promote goth/gothic music, artists, models, photographers, MUAHs, writers, films, venues, businesses & so much more!

feeds.title: Vamp Jenn's Corner » Gothic Music
feeds.description: I'm Jennifer Vasquez. I'm a writer and an avid reader. I was classically trained in voice years ago and once aspired to become an opera singer. I enjoy immersing myself in music, from classical to goth rock tunes. My website covers events, people, places, and topics that embody all that is odd and macabre.

feeds.title: Rabid Hole » Gothic Rock
feeds.description: Read posts about gothic rock written by Rabid Hole in the following segment. I'm a car crash of goth and metal, with punk blood and industrial guts spewing over the steering wheel. I have a life-long fascination with horror, cultural history, death in general, and the occult, love all kinds of animals and I'm extremely outdoorsy.
